title: Buer shows particle charging depends on dynamics, not size
summary: Charles Buer tells of Buer shows particle charging depends on dynamics, not size, about during his 26 years in electrostatics at NASA electrostatics lab, Kennedy Space Center, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: NASA electrostatics lab, Kennedy Space Center

tellings.quote: I was the first to show it has nothing to do with size. It has to do with dynamics.
